name: Tailscale
description: Tailscale mesh-VPN integration. Adds /api/tailscale/{status,login,logout,settings} endpoints and the ref-tailscale reference node so the agent has authoritative docs about the Tailscale CLI. Requires the tailscaled daemon to be running inside the container — that's a system-level concern handled by entrypoint.sh / Dockerfile (gated by SPORE_TAILSCALE_ENABLED=true), not this plugin. Cluster and SSH key workflows belong to the compute-cluster and ssh-sidecar plugins.
